test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-3) Official Paper (Held On: 14 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Boro, an ethno-linguistic community is native to which of the following states/union territories of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Assam.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Boro, an ethno-linguistic community is native to the northeastern state of Assam.**
 
• Bodo tribes are** inhabitants of Garo hills. **
 
• The** language spoken by the Boro people **is recognized by the Indian constitution and** finds a place in the Eighth schedule.**
 
• They are** members of the Sino-Tibetan family.**
 
• They are** polytheist Hindus.**
 
• Most of the people of the** Boro tribe are settlers and farmers.​**
